manifest.notes: Deploy QuantumCanary on Ethereum mainnet with thresholdWei = 1000000000000000000 (1 ETH). Its nonpayable constructor derives the canary public key and address on chain from the fixed SEED_PHRASE. The contract is ownerless and non-upgradeable. Bounties go directly to canaryAddress(). Permissionless poke() records the observed balance high-water mark and first observed trip; isTripped() reads the live balance against the threshold and recorded mark. A refill can clear the live alarm while preserving the first recorded trip. Deployment requires no ETH funding, owner argument, supporting contracts or initialization calls.
